bio: Leslie Gao is currently studying Health Sciences (BHSc) at Queen's University. You can spot him volunteering his time at a youth help phone, working on the newest research papers on Alzheimer's disease, or in a tree. In his natural element. Not only did he publish his own paper in his freshman year, but he also really has an eye, or hand, for art. For instance, he creates art with adults with mixed cognitive abilities and made his own shirt for the Eras Tour! If you really get to know him, he's great at singing "Santa Claus Is Coming to Town," and makes it sound like "Always" by Daniel Caesar. Peak music taste.
name: Leslie Gao
